signal: Onspring launched new AI capabilities for its GRC platform and was named a Leader in Info-Tech's GRC Data Quadrant for the seventh year

email.body1:
Serge, saw Onspring launched new AI capabilities and took the GRC Data Quadrant lead for a seventh year.

That kind of recognition usually surfaces more in-market risk and compliance teams than your reps can cover before the moment passes, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Onspring off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Serge, quick follow-up for Onspring.

With new AI features and the analyst nod driving demand, your target climbs faster than the team can ramp, and most managers cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit it. The gap shows up late, and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Onspring needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Serge, last bit of proof for Onspring.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Onspring's reply rate likely compares to other B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Serge, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything, and I know an AI launch plus analyst momentum keeps a team busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your GRC motion? I will tailor it to Onspring either way.
